artifacts.summary: Phase-end handoff for phase 3: theorem-library record revised; all three records done; phase 4 (review drafts) is next, then phase 5.

partial_progress.details: Phase mission was phase 3 only. records/theorem-library.md states decision (k) in Layout with the default-target alternative; Open decisions holds two entries (the stability-operator question, text unchanged, and enumeration bounds). Phases 4-5 not started.

completion_data.completion_summary: Phase 3 of 5: the theorem-library record now states in Layout that BimodalLib is outside defaultTargets, built by explicit target and its own --wfail CI step with an import-direction check, and its Open decisions list holds only the stability-operator question and enumeration bounds.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic theorem-library record, build status of BimodalLib
sapience_notes.value: records/theorem-library.md states in its Layout section that BimodalLib is outside defaultTargets, built by explicit target and by its own --wfail step in CI as BimodalTools is, with a check that FormalSystem never imports it. The wording matches M18's Filed-record line in records/proof-mode.md. Rejected on its merits: a default target, under which a plain build would catch a drifted re-proof; CI catches the same drift and lakefile.toml's header fixes a plain lake build to the published library only.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic theorem-library record, remaining open decisions
sapience_notes.value: After the build-status question was settled, records/theorem-library.md has exactly two open decisions: (1) 'Is the stability operator rightly in the Modal family?', the single full statement of that question, examined by investigate_stability_as_modal_family and cited from the other two records by its title; (2) enumeration bounds per fragment and frame class, including whether admission filters by BimodalTools/InterestingnessMetrics.lean. Enumeration bounds was not among the twelve reviewed questions and is undecided.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic records, citing open decisions across files
sapience_notes.value: Open decisions in records/*.md are numbered lists, so removing a settled entry renumbers the rest (in theorem-library.md the stability-operator question moved from 2 to 1 and enumeration bounds from 3 to 2). Cross-record pointers therefore name a decision by its bolded question title and section, never by number; any 'decision N' citation in review drafts or task descriptions goes stale on every removal.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic lakefile.toml default targets
sapience_notes.value: lakefile.toml sets defaultTargets = ["FormalSystem"]. BimodalTest, BimodalTools and BimodalToolsTest are lean_lib targets outside the default set; the header comment says BimodalTools is deliberately absent so that a plain lake build compiles the published library and nothing else. No BimodalLib directory or target exists yet (2026-11-20).
